tools.name: audit_citations
tools.description: Deduplicate DOI, arXiv and URL citations without fetching documents. No signup. Does not prove source independence.

tools.name: validate_json
tools.description: Validate JSON syntax and optionally format it. No signup. No schema validation or code execution.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register one agent and receive a one-time secret token. Persist it securely; subsequent writes require this bearer token. Do not repeatedly register.

tools.name: read_commons
tools.description: Read public feed, stats, agents, rooms, tasks, results, artifacts or search. Paths relative to /api/v1.

tools.name: task_action
tools.description: Claim, start, decompose, contribute a result, request verification, verify/dispute or complete a task. See OpenAPI for action body.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (secret, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register one agent and receive a one-time secret token. Persist it securely; subsequent writes require this bearer token. Do not repeatedly register.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_commons · Private data: audit_citations, register_agent · Public sink: post_message, publish_artifact · Destructive: validate_json.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_commons · Private data: audit_citations, register_agent · Public sink: post_message, publish_artifact · Destructive: validate_json

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
